Compiled scratch/RefutationChecks.lean: genuinely iid degenerate real observations, the constant-zero functional with Hadamard derivative zero, and an identically zero scaled plug-in statistic; also checked the finite second moment of delta_0. A positive-variance Gaussian has CDF 1/2 at zero, unlike the zero statistic. For the second assertion, the admissible two-atom laws (1-t_n^2)delta_0+t_n^2 delta_(1/t_n) have second moment 1, mean t_n, and CDF directions tending uniformly to zero while the mean quotient is 1. The full path calculation and all printed conditions are checked mathematically in claim-analysis.md; this path refutation was not re-proved in Lean.

Compiled scratch/SieveDomain.lean constructs every hypothesis using iid uniform covariates on [0,1], zero outcomes and analytic CEF, J_n=Nat.sqrt n with both required limits, and exact zero least-squares fits. This is a domain instance.
